title: “Sabato triste” by Adriano Celentano
text: Adriano Celentano is an Italian singer-songwriter, actor, showman, and filmmaker. He is dubbed Il Molleggiato ('the springy one') because of his energetic dancing.

title: “Non è facile avere 18 anni” by Rita Pavone
text: Rita Ori Filomena Merk-Pavone is an Italian-Swiss pop singer, actress and showgirl, who rose to prominence in the 1960s. Known as "the Mosquito of Turin" (la Zanzara di Torino), she was also nicknamed "Carrot Hair" (Pel di carota) because of the red color of her hair.
listen: Non è facile avere 18 anni Rita Pavone

title: “O mio signore” by Edoardo Vianello
text: Edoardo Vianello is an Italian singer, composer and actor, considered one of the most popular Italian singers of the 1960s.

title: “Please Please Me” by The Beatles
text: "Please Please Me" is a song by the English rock band the Beatles. It was their second single in the United Kingdom, and their first in the United States.

title: “Una lacrima sul viso” by Bobby Solo
text: "Una lacrima sul viso" is a song composed by Lunero and Mogol and performed by Bobby Solo. The song premiered at the fourteenth Sanremo Music Festival, with a double performance by Solo and Frankie Laine, who proposed an English version of the song with the title "For Your Love".
listen: Una lacrima sul viso Bobby Solo

title: “Quando vedrai la mia ragazza” by Gene Pitney
text: Gene Francis Alan Pitney was an American singer, songwriter and musician known predominantly for emotive, dramatic ballads heightened by an expansive range and sorrowful vocals. He also recorded country music.
listen: Quando vedrai la mia ragazza Gene Pitney

title: “Non ho l'età” by Gigliola Cinquetti
text: "Non ho l'età" (Italian for "I'm not old enough (to love you)"), usually given as just "Non ho l'età" (pronounced ), is a song recorded by Italian singer Gigliola Cinquetti, with music composed by Mario Panzeri and lyrics by Nicola Salerno. It represented Italy in the Eurovision Song Contest 1964, held in Copenhagen, winning the contest, having previously won that year's Sanremo Music Festival.

title: “È l'uomo per me” by Mina
text: Mina Anna Mazzini, known mononymously as Mina, is an Italian singer and former actress. She was a staple of television variety shows and a dominant figure in Italian pop and rock and roll music from the late 1950s to the mid-1970s, known for her three-octave vocal range, the agility of her soprano voice, and her image as an emancipated woman.

title: “Cin, cin” by Richard Anthony
text: Richard Anthony was an Egyptian-born French pop singer who had his greatest success in the 1960s and 1970s.

title: “Sei diventata nera” by Los Marcellos Ferial
text: Los Marcellos Ferial are an Italian vocal group, mainly active in the sixties, consisting of Marcello Minerbi, Carlo Timò and Tullio Romano. listen: Sei diventata nera Los Marcellos Ferial

title: “In ginocchio da te” by Gianni Morandi
text: "In ginocchio da te" is a 1964 Italian song composed by Franco Migliacci (lyrics) and Bruno Zambrini (music), arranged by Ennio Morricone and performed by Gianni Morandi. It was considered the number-one song of 1964 in Italy.
listen: In ginocchio da te Gianni Morandi

title: “La mia festa” by Richard Anthony
text: "It's My Party" is the debut song recorded by American singer Lesley Gore on her debut studio album I'll Cry If I Want To. It was released as her debut single on April 5, 1963, by Mercury Records.

title: “Non son degno di te” by Gianni Morandi
text: "Non son degno di te" is a 1964 Italian song composed by Franco Migliacci (lyrics) Luis Bacalov and Bruno Zambrini (music) and performed by Gianni Morandi.
listen: Non son degno di te Gianni Morandi
